vault_lines: Ya llevo tiempo pisando escenarios, pero no me siento tan bien, eh
meaning:
“Ya llevo tiempo pisando escenarios, pero no me siento tan bien, eh” (I’ve been stepping on stages for a while now, but I don’t feel so good, eh)

In this opening line, Peso Pluma explores the “Price of Fame,” a recurring theme throughout the Vultures era. Despite his rapid ascent to the top of the charts, he admits that the adrenaline of performing and the validation of “stepping on stages” hasn’t translated into internal well-being.

This line serves as the thesis for the rest of his verse, where he details the emptiness of material success:


The Void of Wealth: He later mentions having “unos Picasso” (Picasso paintings) but admits “no me lleno con na'” (nothing fills me up). This suggests that even owning world-class art cannot fill the emotional void left by a high-pressure lifestyle.
Coping Mechanisms: He directly links this lack of fulfillment to his mental health, mentioning Alprazolam (Xanax) and Percocet to find “serenidad” (serenity).
It paints a picture of an artist who is surrounded by millions of fans but is struggling with a deep sense of isolation and anxiety.



By starting his contribution to this Kanye and Ty Dolla $ign collaboration with such vulnerability, Peso Pluma aligns himself with the track’s titled theme—being “Drunk” not just on substances, but overwhelmed by the dizzying, often toxic nature of the industry.

Ejaculating (in very crude sexual slang),

“Now you love me”

line: Double O-5, we criminal
vault_lines: Double O-5, we criminal
meaning:
“Double O” refers to Playboi Carti’s and Opiumbaby’s label collective, Opium. The label has a collection of artists, producers, and creatives, such as Ken Carson, Destroy Lonely, Homixide Beno and Homixide Meechie. The double 0 prefix is used by Carti’s inner circle when referring to people affiliated with the label.

“Five,” “5,” or “5ive,” refers to the 5 point star, a symbol frequently used by Piru Bloods to show their alliance to the People Nation. Carti and the Homixide Gang are all affiliated with the Piru Bloods.
